name: Alternate Leg Diagonal Bound
setup: Stand in an athletic stance with open floor (and the box or cones the variation names) in front.
cues: Push the floor away hard and fast.
Land quiet: as little sound as you can.
Stick it still and silent for a two-count before the next rep.

faults.fault: Knees caving in on the landing
faults.fix: Land with the knees out over your laces and stick it.
Land quiet, like a cat; shorten the jump until you can.

cautions: Plyometric: only once landings are quiet and stable. Count contacts, not sets.

name: Depth Jump Leap
setup: Stand on a low box, toes at the edge, with open floor in front.
cues: Step off, do not jump off.
Touch the floor and leave it fast, like the floor is hot.
Land quiet: as little sound as you can.

faults.fix: Lower the box until the contact is short and springy.
Land quiet, on the whole foot, knees over the laces.

cautions: Plyometric: only once landings are quiet and stable. Count contacts, not sets.
Advanced: drop landings stick first, for weeks, before depth jumps.

name: Isometric Chest Squeezes
setup: Set up the way the exercise name describes and enough space to move.
cues: Move on a smooth path at a steady tempo.
Breathe out on the hardest part of the rep.
Stop the set when the path stops being smooth.

faults.fix: Slow to a steady tempo: two counts up, two counts down.
Reset still between reps.

name: Medicine Ball Full Twist
setup: Stand or sit tall holding the med ball in front, feet set wide enough to stay still.
cues: Turn the weight across from hip to opposite shoulder on a smooth path.
Let your hips and upper body turn together, like a door swinging.
Control the return: slower back than out.

faults.fix: Go lighter and move on a smooth two-count.
Root the feet into the floor and turn from the middle.

name: Mountain Climbers
setup: Set the machine or the space up so you can move at a steady pace from the first minute.
cues: Find a rhythm you can hold, then hold it.
Breathe out long every few strides or strokes.
Stay smooth: the same tempo at the end as at the start.

faults.fix: Start at a pace you could talk at, then build.
Shorten the effort or slow the tempo until it stays smooth.

name: Plyo Push-up
setup: Hands a little wider than the shoulders, body in one long line from head to heels.
cues: Push the floor away.
Lower as one plank until your chest is a fist from the floor.
Keep the elbows angled back toward your pockets, not out to the walls.

faults.fix: Brace for a light punch and keep one long line to the floor.
Angle the elbows back toward your pockets.

name: Sledgehammer Swings
setup: Weight a foot in front of you, feet a little wider than your hips. Push your hips back and grip the handle.
cues: Hike the bell back high between your legs, like a football snap.
Snap the hips forward and let the bell float to chest height.
Stand tall at the top: hips through, still for a beat.

faults.fix: Push the wall behind you with your hips; the knees bend only a little.

faults.fault: Lifting the bell with the arms
faults.fix: Let the hip snap float the bell; the arms are ropes.
